blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Parametric Release (參數放行) 的定義及其取代傳統無菌試驗 (Sterility Test) 的法規依據
blocks.en: Understand the definition of Parametric Release and its regulatory basis for replacing the traditional sterility test

blocks.zh: 掌握傳統無菌試驗的固有限制，以及為何製程參數管控能提供更高的無菌保證
blocks.en: Understand the inherent limitations of the traditional sterility test, and why process parameter control can provide a higher level of sterility assurance

blocks.zh: 認識 Sterilization Load Monitor (滅菌負載監控器) 的角色及其在參數放行中的關鍵地位
blocks.en: Recognize the role of the sterilization load monitor and its critical position in parametric release

blocks.zh: 瞭解 FDA 自 1985 年以來接受參數放行的歷史背景及國際法規共識（ICH Q6A、PDA TR30、PIC/S、USP <1222>）
blocks.en: Understand the history of FDA acceptance of parametric release since 1985 and the international regulatory consensus (ICH Q6A, PDA TR30, PIC/S, USP <1222>)

blocks.en: I. Introduction

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Parametric Release (參數放行)：以經過驗證的滅菌製程「關鍵製程參數」(Critical Process Parameters, CPPs) 的達成結果作為批次放行依據，取代傳統的成品無菌試驗。核心邏輯是：如果你能「證明製程已正確執行」，就比「從成品中抽樣檢測」更能保證無菌性。
blocks.en: Parametric Release: Batch release based on meeting the critical process parameters (CPPs) of a validated sterilization process, in place of the traditional finished-product sterility test. The core logic: if you can demonstrate that the process was executed correctly, that is a stronger assurance of sterility than testing samples drawn from the finished product.

blocks.zh: Terminal Sterilization (最終滅菌)：藥品在最終容器中（已完成充填與密封後）進行滅菌處理。與 Aseptic Filling (無菌充填) 的根本差異在於：最終滅菌有一個可量化的殺菌步驟，而無菌充填依賴整個製程鏈的無菌環境維護。
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization: The drug product is sterilized in its final container, after filling and sealing are complete. The fundamental difference from aseptic filling is that terminal sterilization has a quantifiable kill step, whereas aseptic filling relies on maintaining a sterile environment across the entire process chain.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.165(a) 與 211.167(a)：這兩條法規分別規定藥品放行前須符合品質標準、以及無菌藥品須進行無菌試驗。參數放行的法規依據就是用「符合已驗證的製程參數」來「滿足這兩條法規的意旨」(fulfill the intent)——注意 FDA 用的是 "fulfill the intent"，而非 "exempt from"。
blocks.en: 21 CFR 211.165(a) and 211.167(a): These two regulations require, respectively, that drug products meet quality standards before release and that sterile products undergo sterility testing. The regulatory basis for parametric release is that meeting the validated process parameters "fulfills the intent" of both regulations. Note that FDA uses the phrase "fulfill the intent", not "exempt from".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家食品工廠，必須確保每批罐頭都是無菌的。傳統做法是：每批隨機取幾罐打開檢查有沒有細菌（無菌試驗）。問題是，你只開了 20 罐，這批有 100,000 罐——這像在一座大型圖書館隨機翻 20 本書，就宣稱「整座圖書館沒有錯字」。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a food factory and must make sure every batch of canned food is sterile. The traditional approach is to open a few random cans from each batch and check for bacteria (the sterility test). The problem is that you open only 20 cans out of a batch of 100,000. That is like flipping through 20 random books in a large library and then declaring that the whole library has no typos.

blocks.zh: 參數放行的做法是：你不開罐頭，而是確保滅菌鍋在 121°C 以上維持了至少 15 分鐘，所有溫度探針都記錄合格，化學指示劑變色正常。因為你已經科學驗證過「這個條件下所有微生物都會被殺死」，所以製程參數的達成本身就是最強的無菌證據。
blocks.en: Parametric release works differently. You do not open the cans. Instead, you make sure the retort held at 121°C or above for at least 15 minutes, all temperature probes recorded acceptable results, and the chemical indicators changed color as expected. Because you have already scientifically validated that "all microorganisms are killed under these conditions", achieving the process parameters is itself the strongest evidence of sterility.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 適用範圍限定：本 Guidance 僅針對「濕熱最終滅菌」(Moist Heat Terminal Sterilization)。對於輻射滅菌 (Radiation Sterilization) 等其他最終滅菌方式，FDA 建議申請者先與審查部門討論是否適用本指引的原則。
blocks.en: Limited scope: This guidance addresses only moist heat terminal sterilization. For other terminal sterilization methods, such as radiation sterilization, FDA recommends that applicants first discuss with the review division whether the principles of this guidance apply.

blocks.zh: 不涉及驗證細節：本 Guidance 不涵蓋滅菌製程的驗證程序、研究或數據——這些內容在 FDA 另一份指引《Submission of Documentation for Sterilization Process Validation》中。CDMO 在建立參數放行系統時，兩份指引必須同時參考。
blocks.en: Validation details are not covered: This guidance does not cover the validation procedures, studies, or data for the sterilization process; these are addressed in a separate FDA guidance, "Submission of Documentation for Sterilization Process Validation". A CDMO building a parametric release system must refer to both guidances together.

blocks.zh: 法律定位："Does not establish legally enforceable responsibilities"——這是所有 FDA Guidance 的標準但書。但在查廠實務中，偏離 Guidance 建議必須有科學理由和文件支持 **(PDA TR30, Section 1.2)**。
blocks.en: Legal status: "Does not establish legally enforceable responsibilities". This is the standard caveat in every FDA guidance. In inspection practice, however, any deviation from the guidance recommendations needs a scientific justification and supporting documentation **(PDA TR30, Section 1.2)**.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：當客戶委託製造的注射劑採用最終滅菌製程時，CDMO 可評估是否申請參數放行。優勢包括：(1) 無菌試驗耗時 14 天，參數放行可顯著縮短放行時間；(2) 消除因無菌試驗偽陽性導致的批次調查風險；(3) 提供比無菌試驗更高的無菌保證水準。但前提是 CDMO 必須有成熟的滅菌製程驗證體系和完善的製程參數監控系統。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: When an injectable product made for a client uses a terminal sterilization process, the CDMO can evaluate whether to apply for parametric release. Advantages include: (1) the sterility test takes 14 days, and parametric release can significantly shorten release time; (2) it removes the batch investigation risk caused by false-positive sterility test results; (3) it provides a higher level of sterility assurance than the sterility test. The prerequisite is that the CDMO has a mature sterilization process validation system and a robust process parameter monitoring system.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 參數放行與傳統無菌試驗放行相比，為何能提供「更高的無菌保證」？請從統計抽樣的局限性角度說明。
blocks.en: Why can parametric release provide "higher sterility assurance" than release based on the traditional sterility test? Explain from the standpoint of the limitations of statistical sampling.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.165(a) 和 211.167(a) 分別規定什麼？參數放行如何「滿足其意旨」而非「豁免」這些要求？
blocks.en: What do 21 CFR 211.165(a) and 211.167(a) each require? How does parametric release "fulfill the intent" of these requirements rather than "exempt" them?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 同時有濕熱滅菌和輻射滅菌產品線，申請參數放行時的策略會有何不同？
blocks.en: If your CDMO has both moist heat and radiation sterilization product lines, how would your strategy for applying for parametric release differ?

blocks.zh: II. Background 背景
blocks.en: II. Background

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗的統計限制：FDA 在此明確指出傳統無菌試驗的兩大根本缺陷。假設一批產品有 10,000 瓶，依 USP <71> 抽取 20 瓶進行無菌試驗。即使有 1% 的污染率（100 瓶被污染），20 瓶全部合格的機率仍高達約 82%。換言之，傳統無菌試驗只能偵測到「大量污染」，對「低水準污染」幾乎無能為力。
blocks.en: Statistical limitations of the sterility test: FDA clearly identifies two fundamental weaknesses of the traditional sterility test. Suppose a batch contains 10,000 vials and 20 vials are sampled for sterility testing per USP <71>. Even with a 1% contamination rate (100 contaminated vials), the probability that all 20 samples pass is still about 82%. In other words, the traditional sterility test can detect only "gross contamination" and is almost powerless against "low-level contamination".

blocks.zh: 10⁻⁶ SAL (Sterility Assurance Level, 無菌保證水準)："One in a million" 即 SAL = 10⁻⁶，意為每個單位產品的非無菌機率不超過百萬分之一。這是最終滅菌產品的國際公認標準 **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.1)**。
blocks.en: 10⁻⁶ SAL (Sterility Assurance Level): "One in a million" means SAL = 10⁻⁶, i.e. the probability of a non-sterile unit is no more than one in a million per unit of product. This is the internationally accepted standard for terminally sterilized products **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.1)**.

blocks.zh: Sterilization Load Monitor (滅菌負載監控器)：可以是物理指示器（如溫度記錄器）、化學指示器（如 Class 5 整合指示器）或生物指示器（如含有 Geobacillus stearothermophilus 的芽孢條）。FDA 明確指出：load monitor 本身「永遠被視為一個 Critical Process Parameter」。
blocks.en: Sterilization Load Monitor: This can be a physical indicator (such as a temperature recorder), a chemical indicator (such as a Class 5 integrating indicator), or a biological indicator (such as a spore strip containing Geobacillus stearothermophilus). FDA clearly states that the load monitor itself is "always considered a Critical Process Parameter".

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗就像「在一座城市中隨機敲 20 戶人家的門，確認沒有竊賊」。如果這座城市有 10,000 戶，你敲的 20 戶剛好都沒問題，不代表整座城市是安全的。
blocks.en: The sterility test is like "knocking on the doors of 20 random households in a city to confirm there are no burglars". If the city has 10,000 households and the 20 you knocked on happen to be fine, that does not mean the whole city is safe.

blocks.zh: 參數放行則像「在每個入口安裝監視器，並記錄城門在整夜都保持關閉且上鎖」。你不需要逐戶檢查，因為你已經驗證了整個防禦系統的有效性。Load Monitor 就是放在城裡最薄弱位置的「哨兵」，確認最不利條件下也達到了安全標準。
blocks.en: Parametric release is more like "installing cameras at every entrance and recording that the city gate stayed closed and locked all night". You do not need to check every household, because you have verified that the whole defense system works. The load monitor is the "sentry" stationed at the weakest spot in the city, confirming that the safety standard is met even under the worst-case condition.

blocks.zh: Load Monitor 的選型與位置：FDA 建議 load monitor 放置在「appropriate positions」，此位置由開發和確認數據決定。實務上，這意味著必須先完成 Heat Distribution (熱分佈) 和 Heat Penetration (熱穿透) 研究，找出滅菌鍋中的 cold spot (冷點)，再將 load monitor 放置在最不利位置 **(PDA TR30, Section 4.3)**。
blocks.en: Selection and placement of the load monitor: FDA recommends placing the load monitor at "appropriate positions", determined from development and qualification data. In practice, this means heat distribution and heat penetration studies must be completed first to identify the cold spot in the sterilizer, and the load monitor is then placed at the worst-case location **(PDA TR30, Section 4.3)**.

blocks.zh: 化學指示器分級：FDA 引用 ANSI/AAMI/ISO 15882:2008，推薦使用 Class 5 Integrating Indicator（整合指示器），因為其反應與生物指示器高度相關。Class 3 (Specific Test Indicator) 僅在「特定情況」下可接受——例如當 overkill cycle 已充分驗證且 F₀ 值遠超最低要求時。
blocks.en: Classification of chemical indicators: FDA cites ANSI/AAMI/ISO 15882:2008 and recommends Class 5 integrating indicators because their response correlates closely with that of biological indicators. A Class 3 (specific test indicator) is acceptable only in "specific circumstances", for example when an overkill cycle is fully validated and the F₀ value far exceeds the minimum requirement.

blocks.zh: 國際共識：FDA 自 1985 年起接受參數放行。ICH Q6A、PDA TR30 (1999)、USP <1222> (2009)、PIC/S (2007)、EMEA (2001)、日本 (2002) 均已背書——這是一個成熟的、有全球法規共識的做法 **(USP <1222>, Section 1)**。
blocks.en: International consensus: FDA has accepted parametric release since 1985. ICH Q6A, PDA TR30 (1999), USP <1222> (2009), PIC/S (2007), EMEA (2001), and Japan (2002) have all endorsed it. This is a mature practice with global regulatory consensus **(USP <1222>, Section 1)**.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
Sterility Assurance Level (SAL) 計算概念：

SAL = 10⁻⁶ (標準要求)

對於 Overkill Approach：
  F₀ ≥ 12 分鐘 (通常目標 15-20 分鐘)
  假設 Bioburden = 10⁶ CFU，D₁₂₁ = 1 min
  → 滅菌後存活機率 = 10⁶ × 10⁻¹²  = 10⁻⁶ ✓

對於 Bioburden-Based Approach：
  根據實際 bioburden 數據和微生物耐熱性計算
  所需 F₀ 值，確保達到 SAL ≤ 10⁻⁶
blocks.en:
Sterility Assurance Level (SAL) calculation concept:

SAL = 10⁻⁶ (standard requirement)

For the Overkill Approach:
  F₀ ≥ 12 minutes (typical target 15-20 minutes)
  Assume bioburden = 10⁶ CFU, D₁₂₁ = 1 min
  → probability of survival after sterilization = 10⁶ × 10⁻¹²  = 10⁻⁶ ✓

For the Bioburden-Based Approach:
  Calculate the required F₀ value from actual bioburden data
  and microbial heat resistance, to ensure SAL ≤ 10⁻⁶

blocks.zh: CDMO 滅菌負載監控器選型決策：
blocks.en: CDMO decision on selecting the sterilization load monitor:

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，load monitor 的選型直接影響參數放行的可行性：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the choice of load monitor directly affects the feasibility of parametric release:

blocks.zh: Biological Indicator (BI, 生物指示器)：最直接的微生物殺滅證據，但需 48-72 小時培養判讀，可能抵消參數放行的時間優勢
blocks.en: Biological Indicator (BI): The most direct evidence of microbial kill, but it requires 48-72 hours of incubation before reading, which may offset the time advantage of parametric release

blocks.zh: Chemical Indicator (CI, 化學指示器)：結果立即可讀，推薦 Class 5 整合指示器。對多產品線 CDMO 最實用，可實現「當日放行」
blocks.en: Chemical Indicator (CI): Results are readable immediately; a Class 5 integrating indicator is recommended. It is the most practical option for a multi-product CDMO and can enable "same-day release"

blocks.zh: Physical Indicator (溫度探針)：提供連續的 F₀ 數據記錄，通常作為主要監控手段配合 CI/BI 使用
blocks.en: Physical Indicator (temperature probes): Provide continuous F₀ data records and are usually the primary monitoring method, used together with CI/BI

blocks.zh: 多數 CDMO 採用「物理監控（溫度探針 + F₀ 計算）+ Class 5 化學指示器」的組合方案，兼顧科學嚴謹性與放行效率。
blocks.en: Most CDMOs adopt a combined approach of "physical monitoring (temperature probes + F₀ calculation) + Class 5 chemical indicator", balancing scientific rigor with release efficiency.

blocks.zh: FDA 指出無菌試驗有兩大局限性。請分別說明這兩個局限性，並計算：若一批 10,000 瓶產品中有 50 瓶被污染（0.5%），依 USP <71> 抽 20 瓶全部合格的機率約為多少？
blocks.en: FDA identifies two major limitations of the sterility test. Explain each of them, and calculate: if a batch of 10,000 vials contains 50 contaminated vials (0.5%), what is the approximate probability that all 20 vials sampled per USP <71> pass?

blocks.zh: 為何 FDA 將 sterilization load monitor「永遠視為 Critical Process Parameter」？如果 load monitor 結果失敗但所有物理參數（溫度、壓力、時間）都合格，該批次能否放行？
blocks.en: Why does FDA "always consider" the sterilization load monitor a Critical Process Parameter? If the load monitor result fails but all physical parameters (temperature, pressure, time) are acceptable, can the batch be released?

blocks.zh: 比較 Overkill Approach 和 Bioburden-Based Approach 的 F₀ 要求差異。在什麼產品特性下，CDMO 可能需要選擇 bioburden-based approach？**(參考 PDA TR30, Section 3)**
blocks.en: Compare the F₀ requirements of the Overkill Approach and the Bioburden-Based Approach. Under what product characteristics might a CDMO need to choose the bioburden-based approach? **(see PDA TR30, Section 3)**

blocks.zh: FDA 引用了 ANSI/AAMI/ISO 15882:2008 關於化學指示器的分級。Class 5 Integrating Indicator 與 Class 3 Specific Test Indicator 的關鍵差異是什麼？為何 FDA 推薦 Class 5？
blocks.en: FDA cites ANSI/AAMI/ISO 15882:2008 for the classification of chemical indicators. What is the key difference between a Class 5 integrating indicator and a Class 3 specific test indicator? Why does FDA recommend Class 5?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 參數放行的定義：以已驗證滅菌製程的關鍵參數達成作為批次放行依據，取代傳統無菌試驗，滿足 21 CFR 211.165(a) 和 211.167(a) 的意旨
blocks.en: Definition of parametric release: Batch release based on meeting the critical parameters of a validated sterilization process, in place of the traditional sterility test, fulfilling the intent of 21 CFR 211.165(a) and 211.167(a)

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗的局限：受限於(1)小樣本抽樣的統計弱點、(2)培養基對所有微生物生長刺激能力有限，僅能偵測大規模污染事件
blocks.en: Limitations of the sterility test: Limited by (1) the statistical weakness of small-sample testing and (2) the limited ability of the culture media to support growth of all microorganisms, so it can detect only large-scale contamination events

blocks.zh: SAL 10⁻⁶：經驗證的最終滅菌製程可將每個產品單位的非無菌機率控制在百萬分之一以下，遠優於無菌試驗能達到的檢測靈敏度
blocks.en: SAL 10⁻⁶: A validated terminal sterilization process can hold the probability of a non-sterile unit to one in a million or less, far better than the detection sensitivity the sterility test can achieve

blocks.zh: Load Monitor 是 CPP：無論是物理、化學或生物指示器，load monitor 永遠被視為關鍵製程參數，其位置須基於熱分佈/熱穿透研究數據來決定
blocks.en: The load monitor is a CPP: Whether physical, chemical, or biological, the load monitor is always considered a critical process parameter, and its position must be determined from heat distribution/heat penetration study data

blocks.zh: 全球共識：FDA (1985)、ICH Q6A (2000)、PDA TR30 (1999)、USP <1222> (2009)、PIC/S (2007)、EMEA (2001) 均支持參數放行，是成熟且國際認可的做法
blocks.en: Global consensus: FDA (1985), ICH Q6A (2000), PDA TR30 (1999), USP <1222> (2009), PIC/S (2007), and EMEA (2001) all support parametric release, a mature and internationally recognized practice
